units: <cite ref="Megillah 29a:6">Meg. 29ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ ואינו ע׳ מי נדחה מפני מי</he> if one is submissive, and the other is not, which will yield?; <cite ref="Taanit 16a:12">Taan. 16ᵃ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 551:1">Yalk. Jon. 551</cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 40:1">Pesik. R. s. 40</cite> <he>הא ע׳ בן של ע׳</he> O, thou hapless one, son of a hapless mother!; Tanḥ. Vayera 22; ed. Bub. 46; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 56:4">Gen. R. s. 56</cite> <he>ברא דעלובתא</he>).

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 306:1">Sifré Deut. 306</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 938:4">Yalk. Prov. 938</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 6:6">Prov. VI, 6</cite>) <he>ע׳ היה האדם הזה שצריך ללמוד … ע׳ היה וכ׳</he> (<he>ע׳ הוא</he>) it was a (sufficient) humiliation for man that he had to learn from the ant; had he learned and acted (accordingly), he would have been sufficiently humbled, but he was to have learned, and did not.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34:10">Gen. R. s. 34</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00629"><he>עִיסָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>עֲלוּבִים</he>, <he>עֲלוּבִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:4">Gen. R. s. 45</cite>, end, v. <cite ref="P00767"><he>עֶלְבּוֹן</he></cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: (cmp. עֲלַב Ithpe. 2) arrogant, insolent. Sabb. l. c. ע׳ כלה מזנה impudent is &c., v. זָנָה; Cant. R. to VIII, 5; Gitt. 36ᵇ (quoted to prove the meaning of עוּלְבָּנָא = חוּצְפָּא).
